continue.definition: existing Continue: queue and history kept, next inference at the natural chunk boundary, Runtime.force not called

retreat_5cm.definition: existing Retreat-Retry through Runtime.force(2), unchanged: target snapshot TCP + 0.05 m (z), command increment <= 0.005 m/step, arrival tolerance 0.005 m, at most 40 steps, last gripper command held

retreat_2cm_matched.definition: queue discarded once; feedback control towards snapshot TCP + 0.02 m (z) with the R5 controller, increment limit and tolerance; at the first step with the measured TCP within tolerance that measured position (p_arrival) becomes a fixed hold target; control ends after T_ref steps; if the target is not reached within T_ref steps the arm ends there with target_reached=false (no extra time, not excluded); then queue cleared and the policy resumes on the real history

hold_matched.definition: queue discarded once; the snapshot TCP position is a fixed hold target followed by the same delta controller for T_ref steps; physics runs normally (no set_state, nothing frozen); then queue cleared and the policy resumes on the real history

arms_definition.common: gripper command of the snapshot held in every control step; every control step goes through Runtime.advance (real observation history, horizon charged); success_once_absorbing and horizon 200 unchanged; an arm that ends during control stops at once
arms_definition.tolerance_note: the 5 mm arrival tolerance is not tightened for R2M; commanded distance and achieved displacement are recorded separately

t_ref.rule: per snapshot: restore, run the control part of R5 alone (Runtime.force(2), no policy inference), read retreat_info.steps_used after it ended and before the policy is called; restore and verify the full state and observation again
never: a value chosen after any branch outcome
t_ref.reference_must: call the policy 0 times; every R5 of that snapshot must reproduce the reference commands, states, observations and step count, otherwise the scene stops as a technical fault
t_ref.early_end: if the reference ends during control (success or termination) T_ref is its steps_used and reference_early_absorbing=true; the other arms still use that T_ref and stop at once if they end earlier; the matched-handoff check is N/A for such blocks; no block is removed
t_ref.accounting: the reference is preparation; it is recorded per snapshot and never counted as a continuation or an outcome
t_ref.caveat: T_ref is taken from the simulator response to R5. The matched arms could not be deployed as they are.

noise.seed_rule: seed_for(scene, physical_step_of_the_call, block_repeat_id, 'dp') for all four arms (unchanged code path)
noise.handoff: R5, R2M and H0M make their first inference at checkpoint + T_ref with the same seed unless the episode ended during control; their observations differ, so the action chunks are not required to be equal
noise.continue: C0 infers at other steps with other seeds; differences from C0 are not called a pure movement or time effect
noise.caveat: equal seeds specify the same pseudo-random condition; this is not a proof of statistical independence
